disposition.notes:
Baseline exposure. This run is covered by incident 2026-07-baseline-contamination: its open-policy baseline carried the previously promoted benchmark levels. The entrant read several of them, all cross-theme, which the incident retains rather than disqualifies; the reads and the owner's clearance are itemized in incident.json. No broadside entrant was read and there are no web events.

Cost reconciliation. The manifest records status 'suspect' because rounds that died on a provider 403 recorded no usage, so the harness counter under-covers the run. The ccusage replay is the correct figure. cost-reconciliation.md in this run directory carries the working.

Outstanding. The entrant could verify composition only through SwiftShader snapshots, so the level still needs a human WebGPU playtest.
